_help: Pictures page (scrapbook lookbook). Each chapter is a pinned scene the photos fly through as visitors scroll. Put photos in public/images/pictures/ as name.jpg (1600px wide) and name-sm.jpg (900px wide), then list them here. Photos are 3:2 unless you add "w" and "h". 'tag' is the handwritten note. 'colour' is the big title colour.
